sources.title: Elasticsearch current: Index and search analysis

claims.text: Lucene 10.3 documents its inverted index as postings plus a term dictionary: a term maps to an ordered list of documents containing it, while postings do not efficiently retrieve terms given a document without scanning the index.

Elasticsearch current documentation states that text analysis happens at indexing and full-text search time, and that using the same analyzer normally makes indexed values and query strings produce matching token forms; a separate search analyzer is for explicit cases such as prefix search or search-time synonyms.

Elasticsearch documents that text fields are analyzed into terms for full-text search and that multi-fields allow the same string to be indexed differently for search versus exact-value uses such as sorting or aggregations.

Elasticsearch aliases support atomic multi-action add/remove operations, alias routing options, and Query DSL filters; the documentation also states that alias filters do not apply to document retrieval by ID.

Elasticsearch documents optimistic concurrency control using `_seq_no` and `_primary_term`, with conditional writes via `if_seq_no` and `if_primary_term` to prevent an older change from overwriting a newer change.

Elasticsearch documents snapshots as backups that can restore index data and cluster state/configuration, while repository registration, compatibility and sufficient recovery capacity remain operational prerequisites.

The 100M documents, 2KB average source, 20k QPS, 60-second visibility, 150ms P99, 60% utilization target, source-version protocol, authority choice, ACL invariant, checkpoint replay, load-test formulas, rollout thresholds and recovery objectives are explicit scenario assumptions and acceptance criteria. They are not claimed Elasticsearch defaults or production facts.

findings: 1 分钟版已收口为四个可口述主点，3 分钟版移除重复的通用场景模板句并按容量、写路径、查路径、发布恢复分层展开，上一轮 oral_quality 缺陷已关闭。
倒排索引、analysis、alias/routing/filter、乐观并发和 snapshot 的材料性结论继续映射到官方文档；容量数字和恢复阈值均明确标为场景假设而非产品默认值。
两个来源问法均由核心结论、短答、长答、机制与专属追问覆盖，未发现硬失败或未覆盖变体。
